## Summary

Describe the change and link its issue or approved work item.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] List each applicable acceptance criterion and how this change satisfies it.

## Test evidence

- [ ] `make check` (required for scaffold changes)
- [ ] Unit tests (when application code exists)
- [ ] Integration tests with real database and permissions (when applicable)
- [ ] Playwright + axe browser coverage with story IDs (when applicable)

Include commands, results, and any intentionally deferred coverage.

## Security and operations

- [ ] No secrets, private credentials, or production self-hosted runner are used by public CI.
- [ ] Documentation and release notes are updated when needed.
